issues.description: Method Lecture.toString(): the problem statement and template expect a standard Java toString() override that returns String. The solution repository defines the method as 'public Object toString()' with an @Override annotation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 64). This return-type is incompatible with Object.toString()'s declared return type (String) and will cause a compilation error and confuse students about the correct signature to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toString method in the solution to the correct signature 'public String toString()' and return the formatted String. Keep the @Override annotation. Update the solution implementation to 'public String toString() { return "..."; }' so it matches the problem statement example and compiles without error.
